 Title: A Balmy Evening at the Restaurant
Visual description:
As the sun starts to set, casting a warm glow on the quaint streets of Paris, an inviting outdoor restaurant comes into view. The patio is adorned with elegant white tablecloths, each topped with a single red rose in a vase. Guests are seen enjoying their meals under string lights that twinkle as night draws nearer. A friendly waiter, clad in traditional French attire, tends to the guests while carrying a tray filled with steaming servings. Wine glasses filled with ruby-red wine shimmer in their light, and the aroma of rich gastronomy wafts through the air. In the background, a charming fountain adds to the ambiance, its water glistening under the moonlight.
